questions.question: What was King Agrippa's famous response to Paul's testimony?
options: I can find no fault at all in you, none at all
You are very clearly out of your own right mind
You almost persuade me to become a Christian
Tell me a great deal more about this man Jesus
questions.answer: You almost persuade me to become a Christian

questions.question: What did Festus shout during Paul's defense?
options: Almost you persuade me to become a Christian also this day
Guards, take this prisoner away out of my court at once
You are insane, Paul — your great learning is driving you mad
Be silent now, Paul, and speak no more of any of these things
questions.answer: You are insane, Paul — your great learning is driving you mad
